bio.text: Carolyn Hall was elected to the Alaska House of Representatives in 2024 and has represented District 16 (Anchorage) since 2025.

According to her legislative biography, she moved to Alaska in 2008, worked as a television news photojournalist, and holds a master's degree in public administration from the University of Alaska Anchorage.
It lists her as Municipality of Anchorage communications director (2020 to 2021) and Office of the Governor communications manager (2018).
